expect_red: sweep: the draw plan moves only what the run owns -- a mesh moved at one occurrence keeps its others still, and a matched occurrence the mesh does not record is drawn too

mutations.contract: Per mesh, each occurrence is drawn once: a moving occurrence REPLACES its still self in the plan, the mesh's other occurrences stay still, and a matched occurrence recorded elsewhere is added.
mutations.note: The mutation appends every moving occurrence instead of replacing the still entry at the same path, so blade 1's pitch arm would be drawn twice -- once swinging, once frozen where it started.
